For the Petitioner : Mr. Manoj Kr. No.2, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Tapas Roy, A.P.P.
 ....
03/23.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The applicant-husband who is in custody since 16.08.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Chhattarpur P.S. Case No.94 of 2022, for the offence under Sections 302/ 498A and 120B of the IPC.
The applicant is an accused of committing murder of his own wife by hatching conspiracy.
Police after investigation has submitted charge sheet under Section 306 of IPC.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that there is no material to suggest that this applicant has anyhow instigated the wife for commission of suicide.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.

Considering the above fact, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/-
(Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M.1st Class, Palamau at Daltonganj in connection with Chhattarpur P.S. Case No.94 of 2022, subject to the conditions that the applicant will submit self attested copy of his Aadhaar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid/
